description: Tasks. fetch.max_files: how many files one `task fetch` may copy. task_file_reminder: a prompt that wrote task files but not TASK.md is asked once, at Stop, to update it. kb_offer: while a registered knowledge base is not built (`harness kb status`), the agent offers the next step once per session, at a stop of a task that is not itself a kb task. review: a task with [review]=n may use n + extra_checks checks before a person must allow more; max_n caps the n a prompt can ask for; free_invalid: how many checks a round of the task gets back when a FAIL has no finding left after the script drops the ones that point at no file or line, or only at items checked after the write-back. snapshots: how long the copies made at the gates are kept, and the largest file that is copied. report.copilot_events: the task report and the board read Copilot's own session record (~/.copilot/session-state/<session>/events.jsonl) for time and usage, numbers only; false: the hook log only, no usage. mapreduce: after the user typed /generic-mapreduce, the session may call the read-only mapper subagent max_agents times within that many minutes; 0 turns it off. autorun (beta): a task in autorun is pushed on to its next TODO step at most max_steps times within minutes; it stops when the gate refused max_denies calls, or after max_stalls pushes in a row with nothing moved. report.prompt_chars: how many characters of what the user typed the task page shows for each prompt (from Copilot's record; the page only, never given to an agent; a longer prompt is cut and ends in …, and the mouse over it shows all that is kept); 0: none. board: `task board --serve` serves the board on 127.0.0.1:port (a person starts it in a terminal; the browser is paired with a code that is never written down); closed_shown: how many of the newest closed tasks the board lists (the page filters and sorts them); archive_over_mb (1.6.109): the served board measures the task folders once an hour and, over that many MB, asks the person to archive closed tasks (0: never); rewind (1.6.109): at each message of the person the hook keeps a restore point of the task folder (`.task/rewind/`), so the task page can go back to before a message; points: how many are kept (0: none), max_file_mb: a larger file is listed but not kept; refresh_seconds (1.6.11): how often the served page asks for the rows again (3 if missing; the page waits while it is hidden and skips a round while the last request is not back); actions are the buttons that act from the page; pause and resume need no pairing, the others ask for the paired browser and a typed code, as in the terminal. health (1.6.5): the board shows a warning tag on a working task when a rule fires, read from the hook log and Copilot's record, never the conversation: stuck_minutes (no tool call for that long), repeat_commands (the same command that many times in a row), idle_turns (that many model turns with no file change), cost_ratio (Credits at that many times the median of closed tasks of the same kind; with fewer than 3 of them the rule does not fire), context_percent (1.6.8: the context of the bound chat is over that many percent of its window; read from the board's link to VS Code, so only a served board shows it; below Copilot's own compaction at about 80%), context_notice (1.6.35: from that percent the bar is amber and says to compact at a natural stop; no warning tag). Can be added: `review extend`, `review waive`, `review dismiss`, `autorun on`. `recover` stays in the terminal.
